comparisons: Descriptive medians/IQR/ranges and matched-case deltas only; no n=4 inferential tests

controls.low_DMB_margin: Among metadata-matched DMB true positives, smallest nonnegative absolute log-odds distance; not new model inference
controls.order: absolute token-length difference, character-length difference, sample_id
controls.relaxed: Only if strict empty: same source/family, nearest other length region, explicitly separated from strict evidence
controls.reuse: Controls may recur across cases; unique controls reported, not treated as independent replicated rows
controls.strict: same source, existing family and frozen length region; exclude same canonical lineage

hypotheses: Exactly four falsifiable general statistical hypotheses; evidence may be weak; no residual-specific rule

margin.confidence_warning: Near/far are odds-distance descriptions, NOT calibrated confidence
margin.log_odds: logit(score)-logit(point), probabilities clipped only for this diagnostic to [1e-12,1-1e-12]

operating_points: Copied from accepted COMMON-003; never reselected or tuned
phenotypes: All DS FNs stratified by pre-existing STAT-004 length bins; no cluster-count search or latent-phenotype claim
position_and_window: Existing B3-B6 transforms, inherited causal context; no new LM calls; no detector-feature changes
quantiles: numpy linear interpolation; population SD; unscaled MAD; top5=min(5,n); top10%=ceil(.1*n)
references: Reuse held-out fold's accepted S0 training-fold benign references; no References.fit
shape: Upper-tail density uses stored benign length-bin q95, not a new fitted cutoff; max/median null at median=0
structure: Unicode codepoint ratios; punctuation=Unicode category P; entropy=codepoint Shannon bits; word repetition=casefolded regex word counts; fragmentation=reference-token count/characters
